name: Garage Entry
description: Note: Directory name 'garage_entry' is misleading - the video shows reconnaissance/casing behavior (person with clipboard surveying property), not actual garage entry. Consider renaming to 'garage_reconnaissance' or 'casing_photos' for accuracy.

generation.cosmos_prompt: Suburban home driveway at midday, viewed from an elevated position on the garage. A person with a clipboard walks slowly past the house, stopping to write notes while looking at the property, checking sight lines and entry points. Suspicious reconnaissance. Static elevated viewpoint, clear daytime footage. Real-time speed, natural fluid motion at 1x playback rate.
